facts.fact: Per the vendor, ChatGPT ads rollout has expanded to Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, and Brazil.
facts.quote: Since then, the rollout has expanded to Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, and Brazil

facts.fact: ChatGPT ads may appear for logged-in users on Free and Go plans in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, and Brazil.
facts.quote: Ads in ChatGPT may appear for logged-in users on Free and Go plans in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, and Brazil.

facts.fact: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education ChatGPT accounts will not have ads.
facts.quote: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education accounts will not have ads.

facts.fact: OpenAI does not show ads to users who say they are under 18 or who OpenAI predicts are under 18.
facts.quote: OpenAI also doesn’t show ads to users who say they’re under the age of 18, or who OpenAI predicts are under 18.

facts.fact: During the current test, ChatGPT ads do not appear in Temporary Chats, when users are logged out, after an image is generated, or in the ChatGPT Atlas browser.
facts.quote: During the current test, ads don’t appear in Temporary Chats, when users are logged out, after they generate an image, or in the ChatGPT Atlas browser.

facts.fact: ChatGPT ads for Free and Go users can appear below the end of a ChatGPT response, clearly labeled as sponsored.
facts.quote: ads in ChatGPT can appear below the end of a ChatGPT response, where they’re clearly labeled as sponsored

facts.fact: Each ChatGPT ad includes the brand's name, favicon, headline, description, and image asset, linking to the brand's landing page.
facts.quote: Each ChatGPT ad includes the brand’s name, favicon for the brand’s logo, headline, description, and image asset

facts.fact: OpenAI states that advertiser 'context hints' do not work like exact-match keywords and do not guarantee an ad will appear in a specific conversation.
facts.quote: don’t guarantee that an ad will appear in a specific conversation

facts.fact: ChatGPT ad targeting is currently based on contextual relevance and the geographic areas marketers choose.
facts.quote: Targeting is currently based on contextual relevance and the geographic areas marketers choose for their campaigns.

facts.fact: Advertisers can buy ChatGPT ads through OpenAI's self-serve Ads Manager Beta or through a technology partner such as StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Advertisers can buy and manage ads on ChatGPT by signing up for OpenAI’s self-serve Ads Manager Beta or by working with a technology partner like StackAdapt.

facts.fact: Per McKinsey (cited by the vendor), half of consumers use AI-powered search to research and discover products and services.
facts.quote: half of consumers use AI-powered search to research and discover products and services today

facts.fact: Per McKinsey (cited by the vendor), 44% of AI-powered search users say it is their primary method for deciding what to buy.
facts.quote: with 44% of users saying it’s their primary method for deciding what to buy.

facts.fact: Per OpenAI (cited by the vendor), ChatGPT has over 900 million weekly active users worldwide.
facts.quote: over 900 million weekly active users worldwide

facts.fact: Per eMarketer (cited by the vendor), a third of the US population is expected to use ChatGPT this year.
facts.quote: a third of the US population

facts.fact: ChatGPT currently supports one ad format, with a square image asset at a 1:1 aspect ratio and 256×256 pixel resolution.
facts.quote: ChatGPT currently supports one ad format. Each ad uses a square image asset with a 1:1 aspect ratio and 256×256 pixel resolution

facts.fact: ChatGPT ad headlines are limited to up to 30 characters.
facts.quote: a headline of up to 30 characters and body copy of up to 60 characters

facts.fact: Users may see a single ad unit below a ChatGPT response when there is a relevant match, and that unit may include one or more items from the brand.
facts.quote: users may see a single ad unit below a ChatGPT response when there’s a relevant match, and that unit may include one or more items from the brand.

facts.fact: Advertisers can add UTM parameters to the target URL of ChatGPT ads to support campaign tracking.
facts.quote: Advertisers can also add UTMs to the target URL to support campaign tracking

facts.fact: Advertisers do not receive users' chats, chat history, memories, names, emails, precise location, IP address, or sensitive information from ChatGPT ads.
facts.quote: Advertisers also don’t receive users’ chats, chat history, memories, names, emails, precise location, IP address, or sensitive information.

facts.fact: Per the page, early access to ChatGPT ads is generally better suited for industries with fewer regulatory restrictions.
facts.quote: early access to ChatGPT ads is generally better suited for industries with fewer regulatory restrictions

facts.fact: Advertisers can access ChatGPT ad reporting metrics including impressions, clicks, CTR, average CPC, average CPM, amount spent, and conversions.
facts.quote: This includes core campaign metrics like impressions, clicks, click-through rate, average CPC, average CPM, amount spent, and conversions.
